MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The metric screw assortments fit my recent fastener purchases, especially the stainless steel kit with M2 and M2.5 sizes that extend my M3–M5 assortment.",
    "The caliper relates to checking fastener dimensions, although I would wait for a specific measuring task before choosing it."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The filament recommendations assume a printing need that my recent purchases do not establish; different colors and materials do not make them useful to me now.",
    "The electrical connectors and heat shrink tubing require particular wiring tasks I have not indicated, and a second screw assortment would overlap with the one I would choose."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in small hardware seems to have been stretched into an interest in 3D printing supplies.",
    "Buying screws described for electronics seems to have been taken as a reason to recommend specialized wiring supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The practical purpose and exact dimensions matter: smaller metric fasteners add something useful to the sizes I recently bought.",
    "My repeated magnetic hook purchases suggest an interest in magnetic mounting that this selection barely reflects.",
    "I rarely choose something without a concrete use, so a potentially useful tool or another overlapping assortment is not enough to prompt a purchase."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my need for practical fasteners but stretch that interest into printing and wiring projects I have not shown a need for."
}
